title: Length of Compiled Procedure Bodies
statement: Let $G$ be a code layout, let $bs$ be a finite list of statements, and let $p\in\mathbb N$ be a starting instruction position. For each statement, compile it at its current position and append the five-instruction epilogue; after processing a statement $b$, advance the position by its size at frame width $G.F$ plus five. The final position equals $p$ plus the length of the concatenated compiled code.
